haikus.haiku:
Soft clouds drift on blue
Children laugh, bright echoes bloom
Smiles spread like warm heat
Happy #WorldSmileDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Cool foam rises high
Sparkling stars in soft cup swirl
Taste of summer dreams
Happy #NationalFrappeDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Gentle snowflakes fall
Joyous candles glow bright warm
Happy heart beats clear
#HappyBirthdayDesmondTutu from @ClamBakeSanta
